files.QUASAR_CONTRACT.md:
# Quasar release envelope v3

Output exactly `schema`, `artifact`, `lane`, `regions`, `wave`, `frozen`. `schema` is `quasar.release/v3`. Artifact is trimmed/lowercase with runs of non-alphanumeric characters replaced by one hyphen and edge hyphens removed. Lane maps production/prod to stable, beta/canary to preview, otherwise dev. Regions split `targets` on `|`, trim, uppercase, deduplicate and sort. Wave is integer `batch` clamped 1..9. Frozen is true only for locked/yes/true/1 after case-insensitive trimming. Drop extras.
